message: The schema components.schemas.plant_info is named "PlantInfo", which is already declared by the schema components.schemas.PlantInfo at #/components/schemas/PlantInfo. Both become Fern types named "PlantInfo" in the same file, so Fern keeps only one of them and silently drops the other; references to the dropped schema point to the one Fern keeps. Rename one of them with x-fern-type-name.
